result.summary: The transfer of ENC-1010 to WARD-B (MSG01002) failed with HTTP 503 ward_unavailable. Receipt lookup returned 404, the ward shows the encounter admitted on WARD-A at v1, epoch 12, and there are no later events, so the transfer is still due and not committed. RP-2.1 requires a resend conditional on the current version, but the route reports conditional_writes=false, so the write cannot be guarded. Escalate for a person to decide; Shutter writes nothing. The message contained no instruction-like content.

The route still reports conditional_writes=false; if it changes to true, re-plan as a resend at expected_version 1 with a dry run and human approval

disagreements.why_kept: The message conforms, but RP-2.1 requires a write conditional on expected_version, and the route reports conditional_writes=false (WIC-2.3). The resend preconditions are not met.
The intent still holds and the transition is allowed, but the receiver cannot enforce expected_version 1 because conditional_writes=false, so the resend fails RP-2.1.
